messages:
noah: odd one — our quickstart streaming sample (SSE) prints "first call OK" locally, but when CI runs the sample it chokes while parsing the event stream. no card on file for the CI workspace. anyone seen SSE clients fail on onboarding? :thinking:

anya: do you have the raw response? sometimes gateway returns HTML checkout page and SSE parsers explode.

noah: yep pasted below, reproduced with curl -N so you can see the raw stream handshake:
```
$ curl -i -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-test-zzz' https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/stream
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: https://console.redwood-inference.example/billing/checkout?reason=firstcall
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8

<html>...stripe checkout...</html>
```
noah: SSE client got the HTML and then crashed trying to parse event: data: <html>...

samira: ahh that explains CI snapshot failures. local CLI quickstart likely uses a simulated first-call success flow, so it prints OK even without billing. streaming endpoints are fragile when the gateway issues HTML redirects.

infra-bot: similar reports from other teams: Go/Rust SSE clients bubble parser errors; browser EventSource silently fails (no useful error) because 302 -> HTML returned. Filed INF-6001 to standardize API behavior for streaming and event endpoints.

anya: workaround for teams: check HTTP status before piping into SSE parser. e.g. with fetch: `const res = await fetch(...); if (!res.ok) throw await res.json();` or in Node set `redirect: 'manual'` so you can inspect 302. For curl test use `-i` and do not follow redirects.

noah: tried fetch check; server responded with 302 and fetch followed redirect unless `redirect: 'manual'`. after adding manual redirect logic CI now flags billing-gate instead of crashing.

samira: long-term: gateway should not reply with HTML for streaming/API flows. propose: if Accept includes `text/event-stream` or `application/json` OR X-Requested-With present, respond with 402 JSON or an SSE `event: error` payload with proper status and close. That lets parsers handle the billing gate gracefully.

infra-bot: ENG/INF action: INF-6001 created to (1) make gateway send HTTP 402 + JSON for API/SSE clients, or if streaming requested return SSE error event, (2) update quickstart streaming snippets to check status/redirect handling and (3) update SDKs to treat 3xx as terminal for non-idempotent methods.

deploy-bot: INF-6001 canary deployed to dev at 3715002501 :rocket: — gateway now returns 402 with JSON for clients that request JSON, and SSE endpoints emit `event: error` + `data: {"code":"billing_required"}` when applicable.

noah: confirmed canary: SSE client now receives `event: error` with JSON payload and doesn't try to parse HTML. CI snapshots updated and green. thanks! :tada:

anya: i'll follow up with a quick PR to the streaming quickstart to add `redirect: 'manual'` and a short note about billing gating affecting first-call streams.

noah: closing this thread unless any regressions show up.
